subject: english
question: **Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:** Was the conclusion reached by the jury after reviewing all the evidence?

options.text: Did the jury reach the conclusion after reviewing all the evidence?
Was all the evidence reviewed after reaching a conclusion by the jury?
Had the jury reached a conclusion by the time the evidence was reviewed?
Did the evidence conclude the jury's review?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Was the conclusion reached by the jury after reviewing all the evidence?" 
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the subject "the jury" and make it the subject of the active voice sentence. 
 
• Change the verb structure: "was reached" becomes "did reach." 
 
• Ensure the time phrase and object, "after reviewing all the evidence," remain intact for clarity. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Did the jury reach the conclusion after reviewing all the evidence?"* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: **"Did the jury reach the conclusion after reviewing all the evidence?" – This is the correct active voice conversion. 
 
• **Option 2: **"Was all the evidence reviewed after reaching a conclusion by the jury?" – Incorrect as it remains in passive voice. 
 
• **Option 3: **"Had the jury reached a conclusion by the time the evidence was reviewed?" – Incorrect tense (past perfect). 
 
• **Option 4: **"Did the evidence conclude the jury's review?" – Incorrect meaning as it changes the intended subject.
